I have it with me now, gob. Let's trade, gob!

You finally showed your true colors!
W-who are you guys, gob?!\nI-I'mma finish you all, gob!!
I...I...I can't even groan in pain, gob...
Why did you guys try to get Lefina's sweets?\nSpit it out!
Because I heard that we can gain incredible\npower if we eat the sweets she makes, gob...
Huh?
No, I heard that we can summon awesome monsters\nwith the sweets, gob.
Jeez...
Wrong, gob! I heard we can transform into a\nfantastic figure with great power, gob!
Oh~...They knew everything...Argh~...
Stop right there!
Filecia?! Where did you come from?!
I've seen everything...You've been toying with\nLefina's innocence to get things for your\nbusiness...
Even if heaven forgives you, I will not forgive\nyou!!
Eeek!
I'll teach you a lesson with my own hands!!
Eeeeeeek!!
Eh, oh!\nOh nooo! Help meeee!
Y-yeah, that one, gob!\nThat's the kind of sweets I want, gob!\nPlease sell them to me, gob!!
What?
Eeeek!! Nah, nothing, gob.\nI-I-I-I'm sorry, gob!!
Those Broker Goblins and that handsome merchant\nhave left these sweets behind...\nWhat do we do with them now?
Well...Although Lefina was the one who made them,\nthey're just normal sweets...\nSo let's just take them home!
Oh my gosh, how should we tell Lefina that she\nactually got fooled? It's giving me a headache~...

Sorry for keeping you waiting!
What took you so long...
Oh?! You guys...
You tried to mess with Lefina not once, but twice!\nHow could you not learn your lesson?\nYou sure got a lot of guts, huh!
To respect your courage, I'm going to knock you\ndown with the magic Lefina created!
Whoaaaaat?!
Gyahahhahhahha!\nGyahahha, gyahahha, gyahahhahha!
Uoogh, ugh, ughh, aagh,\nUgh, ughh, help meeee!!
Oh my, oh my gosh?!\nW-w-wait, hey, that was dangerous!!
Gyahahha! T-that was not in my plan.
Gyahahhahha! That Adonius guy was too weak, and\nI have too much energy left, gyahha!\nI haven't had enough!
Gyahahhahha! But if I keep going like this, I may\nbe stopped by the sentry who guards the town!!
Gyaaahahhahha! Could you please stop me with\nyour power?!

T-thank you...\nP-please keep this secret from Lefina...
Um, yeah. She's still gloomy and trying to forget\nthat Adonius guy, I shouldn't remind her of him...

...Okay, this time do it this way...
Got it, gob. I've also prepared the thing just for\nthat, gob!
Oh? We saw you guys too last time...\nYou haven't learned your lesson, have you?
N-no, no, wait! We already know how scary that\nElven girl is, gob!
We won't dare to go against her again, gob!\nWe've really changed, gob!
So, what are you guys doing here?
Well, to atone for what we did last time, we're\nthinking of making some sweets too.
At this time of the year, people are making\nsweets, gob?
So we also wanna make them and hand them out to\nthe brats...I mean the children, gob...
Anyway, where are you guys going?
We were asked by Filecia to gather the ingredients\nfor her sweets...
Ohh! That's perfect! Do you guys mind gathering\nthe ingredients for us too?
Huh...? For you guys? Hmm, but we need to gather\nthem for Filecia first, though...
Is...is it not possible to do it at the same time?
We wanna prove that we've really changed for the\nbetter, please gather them for us, gob!!
Agree to help
Don't believe them
But Filecia said she would reward us, so I think\nwe still need to prioritize her.
If that's the problem, we'll also reward you!\nBesides, we only need a few ingredients, so please\ngather them for us first...
Really?! I guess we can help. I don't really care\nabout abstract things like bonds or trust anyway.\nSomething concrete like a reward is better.
But still, I find it hard to trust you~. Besides,\nthere's no reward. Yeah, no reward from you.\nYou don't offer us any reward...
O-of course we have prepared a reward for you!\nBesides, we only need a few ingredients, so please\ngather them for us first...
P-please believe us, gob! We've prepared it\nproperly for this moment, gob!
Oh, really ♪? You should have said so earlier~!\nOkay then, leave it to us! We'll get you the\ningredients, just wait here!
Let's go then! Make sure you follow me!
We're back, gob!
Have you talked to those two, gob?!
Yeah, that scary girl had asked them to gather the\ningredients indeed, gob!
Great...! With the ingredients that girl\nrequested, I should be able to make the finest\nsweets.
I'll find a way to make them myself somehow.\nBy the way, how are things on your end?\nI assume you've got everything ready too, right?
It's all good, gob! I've got "something" special\nready just in case, gob...!
Oh! You really brought us the ingredients!
Of course! Alright, lemme get my reward~♪!
Huh?! W-what?
You've gathered the ingredients correctly, gob!
Thanks for your hard work, gob!
We can make delicious sweets with them, gob...!
That's what they are for, right?
Yeah, we asked you to gather them for that\nindeed.
Something isn't right here...\nI thought you said you'd changed and wanted to\nmake sweets?
Did you really think that we had changed, gob?\nHow foolish!
H-hey, wait! So, what about our reward?!
Shut up!!\nIf you insist on getting your reward, take this!!
H-how dare you deceive us!!\nHey, take care of them!!
D-darn it!!\nI'll cut you some slack today, gob!!
H-hey, wait for meee...!
Oh, well...\nAt least we got the ingredients back.
It can't be helped...\nLet's take them to Filecia!
